statements.statement: The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations
The patient has episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptomatic events have persisted despite initial evaluation
A mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered
The study is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
CPT 93229 requires prior approval for coverage
